decision.next_research_gate: If H01 or any other hypothesis remains of interest after this screen, translate it into a class-neutral, pre-frozen U0-to-T2 rule and test it only after accepted licensed/PIT data and execution ledgers are available.
reason: Any apparent public-series hurdle survivor is only a hypothesis for an entitled, point-in-time replay; it is not total-return, product-admission, allocation or action evidence.
The candidate family must be judged together. Sensitivity to horizon, risk budget or breadth is evidence against treating a single public-series survivor as a stable return process.
The public panel is a coverage-restricted, retrospective four-ETF observation with overlapping windows; it does not establish an out-of-sample holdout or open-universe result.
UR01--UR05, U0 freeze, accepted data modules, formal replay, route/cost evidence and prospective paper reconciliation remain open.

prior_public_overlap_observation.interpretation: Both inputs are public observations. Agreement cannot prove adjustment basis, source vintage, historical availability, total return, or execution quality; differences must remain visible.

protocol.accounting_model: Monthly self-financing units-and-cash simulation. At each observed open, turnover equals one half of the absolute change from drifted pre-trade security-plus-cash weights to target component weights. Cost equals pre-trade observed-open NAV multiplied by that turnover and the stated sensitivity. Units then drift until the next scheduled monthly rebalance.
protocol.annual_metric_boundary: Annual rows carry forward prior-session NAV. Initial and cutoff-year fragments are explicitly marked incomplete and are not used for a separate annual hurdle.

asset_scope.scope_warning: A four-ETF observation is not the open domestic universe, a frozen U0 population, or a future decision universe.

protocol.cost_model: Per-one-way-turnover cost sensitivity only. It excludes verified fees, taxes, bid/ask, market impact, T+1, lots, halts, limits, settlement, no-fill and capacity.
protocol.decision_frequency: first observed session of each calendar month after the full lookback exists; the warm-up waits for a month boundary rather than entering mid-month
protocol.information_timing: signal uses closes only through the previous observed session; target is executed at the next observed session open and marked to that same session close
protocol.rebalance_frequency: Every scheduled monthly execution rebalances drifted units to the target, even when the target sleeve set has not changed.
protocol.return_basis: Observed public open-to-close and close-to-next-open market-price arithmetic inside a self-financing accounting model; no investor total-return interpretation is permitted.
protocol.selection_rule: At each monthly decision, rank risk sleeves with positive lookback public-series price change, select the stated top N, equal-weight selected risk sleeves within the stated risk budget, and assign the residual to 511010; if none qualifies, assign 100% to 511010.

dependencies.limitations: The dependency is a public, non-entitled observation and cannot enter a formal replay or strategy decision.
dependencies.purpose: A prior public observation is read only to expose cross-capture close differences; it does not validate price basis, total return, availability or execution.

source_freeze.boundary: Case-local hash control only. It detects a raw-source mismatch during scripted verification, but does not establish external notarization, data rights, point-in-time availability, total return or execution quality.
